## Task
An anonymous black-box function of 2 continuous inputs in [0, 1]; lower is better.

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_a60` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_4d6` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `y`: objective; minimize (lower is better).

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.

But wait — is y = a*exp(b*x_a60)? At 0.019: 8.2; at 0.472: 17.3. Hmm, ratio 2.1 over a delta of 0.45. From 0.525 to 0.978: 90.9/17.4 = 5.2 over 0.453. So it's accelerating — probably exponential or quadratic. If quadratic: y ≈ a + b*x + c*x^2. Three points:
x=0.0192: 8.203
x=0.4722: 17.324
x=0.5251: 17.439
x=0.9781: 90.851

Fitting a quadratic with points 0, 3, 1: 8.203 = a + 0.0192b + 0.000369c; 17.324 = a + 0.4722b + 0.2230c; 90.851 = a + 0.9781b + 0.9567c.
Subtracting eq1 from eq2: 9.121 = 0.4530b + 0.2226c.
Subtracting eq2 from eq3: 73.527 = 0.5059b + 0.7337c.
From the first: b = (9.121 - 0.2226c)/0.4530 = 20.134 - 0.4914c.
Substituting: 73.527 = 0.5059(20.134 - 0.4914c) + 0.7337c = 10.186 - 0.2486c + 0.7337c = 10.186 + 0.4851c.
c = 63.341/0.4851 = 130.57. b = 20.134 - 0.4914*130.57 = 20.134 - 64.16 = -44.03. a = 8.203 - 0.0192*(-44.03) - 0.000369*130.57 = 8.203 + 0.845 - 0.048 = 8.999 ≈ 9.0.

So the quadratic fit is y ≈ 9 - 44x + 130.6x², and the minimum is at x = 44/(2*130.6) = 0.168, with y ≈ 9 - 7.39 + 3.69 = 5.30. And the point at x=0.525: 9 - 23.1 + 35.78 = 21.68, but observed is 17.44 — not a perfect fit. In any case, this suggests the true minimum is somewhere in the interior around x_a60 ≈ 0.15-0.2, not on the boundary!

notebook.text: Opening: no prior knowledge, 2D box, noiseless, 30 evals, simple regret. Plan: ~6 Sobol space-filling points first (model uninformative before that), then logei/ucb-driven refinement around the best region, keeping 1-2 exploration evals for other basins, final evals exploit the incumbent.

Data so far: y(0.02,0.53)=8.20 best; y(0.98,0.30)=90.85; y(0.53,0.97)=17.44; y(0.47,0.20)=17.32. x_a60 drives y (sens 0.88), x_4d6 flat (sens 0.12). GP cv_r2 0.08 — unreliable. My quadratic through extremes: y≈9−44x+131x², min at x≈0.17, y≈5.3 (interior dip). Testing x_a60≈0.18: expect ~5.3 (new best) if quadratic right, ~12+ if GP monotone-rise right.

Valley structure: y = 0.7327 + 225.5*(x_a60-0.1971)^2 fits the 4 on-axis (x_4d6=0.5) points near-perfectly (residuals <0.01). Off-axis: (0.1971,0.42)=5.38, (0.1909,0.7486)=16.9 -> floor is THIN in x_4d6 (width ~0.04-0.08). GP useless inside the valley (cv_r2 0.27, negative predictions). Plan: probe (0.1971,0.46) and (0.1971,0.54) to locate z-center/width, then polish min; keep ~2 evals for other-basin hedge.

New best 0.4325 at (0.1971,0.4845). Local model: y ≈ 0.4325 + 210*(x-0.1971)^2 + ~1180*(z-0.4845)^2 fits all 9 valley points well (far points saturate -> single deep thin valley, low 2nd-basin risk). Coordinate centers pinned to ~0.001. Open question: cross term (rotated ellipse) could shift joint min toward (+x,-z) by up to ~0.09 in y. Test at (0.213,0.478): expect ~0.53 if axis-aligned, ~0.34 if rotated. Then hedges far away; keep filling budget with distant probes (early stop not allowed).

Fit through valley points (ref x0=0.1971,z0=0.4845): y ≈ 0.4325 + 0.011u + 2.554v + 225u² + 971uv + 1085v². Hessian [[450,971],[971,2170]]: eigenvalues ~12.7 (flat dir (+x,−z)) and ~2607. Predicted joint min (0.271,0.450), y≈0.39. Caveats: flat dir extrapolated 0.07 with little data; z-wall below center steeper than quadratic (residuals +0.14/+0.61 at v=−0.025/−0.065). Next: step halfway to predicted min at (0.2415,0.4645).

Incumbent 0.3979 at (0.2105,0.4824). Two Newton steps matched predictions to <0.001 -> local min pinned, expected local gain <0.001. x-cross-section z=0.5: parabola 218x²-86x+9.2, min at 0.197 (the valley) -> no 2nd dip along x. Precedent: valley was hidden between 8.2 and 17.3 samples, so unexplored cells can still hide a dip. Hedge plan (~5 pts): cell centers (0.4,0.65), (0.1,0.2), (0.1,0.85), (0.75,0.6), (0.75,0.15); expected y~8-20 each (macro parabolic walls). Dig in if any <5. Must use all 30 (no early stop); incumbent is safe either way.

Incumbent 0.3979 @ (0.2105,0.4824) after 23 evals. All 3 nearest-neighbor polishes worse (0.418, 0.420, 0.405). GP now reliable (cv_r2 0.65): floor ~0.38-0.39 centered ~(0.208-0.211,0.480-0.484), but under-predicts the incumbent by 0.015, so its argmax is statistically TIED with incumbent. Conclusion: 0.3979 is the true valley min to within resolution; further polish is coin-flip. Plan: 1 final clean exploit at GP argmax (0.2085,0.4824); if it doesn't beat incumbent, accept 0.3979 and fill remaining budget with low-stakes confirmation that the valley floor is mapped.

VERDICT: incumbent 0.3979 @(0.2105,0.4824) is the valley minimum — GP (cv_r2 0.65, flat floor ~0.387 centered on incumbent) + 5 worse neighbors (min +0.002) + noiseless problem = no credible point beats it. Remaining 6 evals: ring lottery tickets r~0.005-0.01, SW/NE corners first. No second basin (6 hedges 4.7-94, clean cross-sections). Spend 25: (0.206,0.4795).
